caseName: Cincinnati Traction Co. v. City of Cincinnati
caseNameFull: Cincinnati Traction Company v. City of Cincinnati
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Ohio.
attorneys: Mr. Joseph Wilby, Mr. Alfred C. Cassatt and Mr. Ellis G. Kinkead for plaintiffs in error. Mr. Saul Zielonka, Mr. Charles A. Groom, Mr. William Jerome Kuertz and Mr. Charles E. Weber for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Consolidated Turnpike Co. v. Norfolk &c. Ry. Co., 228 U. S. 596; Bilby v. Stewart, 246 U. S. 255, 257; Municipal Securities Corporation v. Kansas City, 246 U. S. 63, 69; Cuyahoga River Power Co. v. Northern Realty, Co., 244 U. S. 300.
